_comment: All alike (notes/strange-words-plan.md 4). `uniform features` stamps every tree and boulder from one shape,
so every oak is the same oak -- the stamped-shapes step, written on purpose. `uniform landmass` keeps to
the landforms laid out on a plan or with none at all -- pyramids, pillars, the flat -- and nothing torn, and
smooths what wear would break up. It cannot mean one biome or one creature: `only` already says that.
